triage_method: manual batch triage by the audit-routine model: keyword shortlist (מחקר/דו"ח/סקר/נתונים/אחוז/study/report/survey/university/institute etc.) over all 476 candidate headlines narrowed to 23 keyword hits, PLUS a full manual read-through of all 476 headlines (the keyword filter alone was judged too aggressive given the news mix) to catch data-shaped claims without those exact keywords.
environment_note: WebFetch is EGRESS_BLOCKED for this session for all outlet domains and even unrelated domains (ynet.co.il, mako.co.il, haaretz.co.il, themarker.com, cbs.gov.il, en.wikipedia.org all confirmed blocked on live tests) — same constraint as the 2026-09-28 precedent run. WebSearch (Anthropic-hosted) works and was used for both article-body reconstruction and primary-source research. Article bodies were not fetched directly; body_ok=0 for all outlets unless an audit subagent found an allow-listed mirror.
news_cycle_note: The 2026-09-28–29 window was dominated almost entirely by the Egypt/UAE Oct-7-warning scandal against Netanyahu, the pre-election horse race, and Ireland-Israel match/war coverage. This left an unusually thin harvest of genuine data stories.

remaining_headlines_note: The other ~460 of the 476 new headlines were war/security/political event coverage (dominated by the Egypt/UAE Oct-7-warning story and pre-election coverage), the Ireland-Israel match, human-interest and entertainment features, personal-finance advice columns, live-blog/short-form news items, and sponsored/native content, with no citable study/survey/report behind a specific empirical claim, or fell under the registry/event-measurement/market-data/election-poll exclusions; they were not individually recorded to keep this file's size reasonable.
note_on_cap: Fewer than 12 stories were selected: the 2026-09-28–29 homepage window was even more dominated by a single political scandal and pre-election coverage than the 2026-09-28 precedent day. Seven stories with a genuine citable-source claim were identified; two additional maybes (cannabis-bust tally, airline-delay ranking) were dropped — one for scope, one for lack of a recoverable checkable claim.
